_comment: Repositories the gold sets are written against, pinned to the commit they
were authored at. `python3 tests/fetch_repos.py` shallow-clones each one at
its pin and builds an index, so anyone can reproduce the eval numbers rather
DDG and blinkit are evaluated locally but not listed here: the DuckDuckGo iOS
checkout used was a source snapshot rather than a clone, and blinkit is a
private app repo. Their gold sets ship anyway — point --repos-dir at your own
copies if you have them, and eval.py skips what it can't find.
